'''May 2000 San Antonio tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Antonio, Texas on 20 May 2000. [[Brian Guthrie]] won it. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d778">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-san-antonio-texas-5-20d778/ san-antonio-texas-5-20], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-san-antonio-texas-5-20d778/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Site:''' San Antonio, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Guthrie]]
